Xech X-Charge MAG Power Bank 10000mAh – 15W Fast Wireless Charging with Kickstand

The Xech X-Charge MAG Power bank 10000mAH is engineered for users who expect speed, safety, and convenience in one sleek device. Designed with powerful rare earth magnets, this magnetic wireless power bank snaps securely to your compatible smartphone and starts delivering instant power. Whether you are traveling, commuting, attending meetings, or gaming, you can charge up to three devices at the same time without messy cables.

With 15W fast wireless charging, dual USB output, and a versatile USB-C port, this portable charger ensures your phone, earbuds, smartwatch, or tablet stay powered throughout the day. The integrated kickstand doubles as a smartphone holder, making it perfect for video calls, streaming, and hands-free viewing while charging.

Built for modern lifestyles, the power bank supports bi-directional USB-C along with QC 3.0 and PD wired fast charging, meaning the battery pack itself recharges quickly too. The LED battery indicator keeps you informed about remaining power so you are never caught off guard.

  • 10000mAh high-capacity battery for all-day backup power
  • Magnetic attachment with powerful rare earth magnets for a secure Snap-On fit
  • 15W fast wireless charging for compatible smartphones
  • Charge 3 devices at once – wireless + USB-C + USB-A
  • Dual USB output for simultaneous wired charging
  • USB-C port with bi-directional input & output
  • QC 3.0 PD wired fast charging for rapid power delivery
  • Built-in kickstand for movies, calls, and gaming
  • Smartphone holder design for hands-free usage
  • LED battery indicator for real-time capacity status
  • Advanced safety protection against overcharge, overheating & short circuits
  • Compact, travel-friendly, and lightweight design

Magnetic Convenience Meets Fast Charging

Forget carrying extra cables everywhere. The magnetic alignment ensures perfect positioning for efficient wireless charging every time. The strong hold prevents slips, even when you are texting or taking calls. This makes the Xech X-Charge MAG ideal for everyday commuters, travelers, students, and professionals.

Power More, Wait Less

The combination of 15W wireless output and PD/QC 3.0 wired technology delivers rapid charging speeds. Need to power multiple gadgets? Use the wireless pad while connecting two additional devices via USB-C and USB-A. You get maximum productivity without downtime.

Designed for Entertainment & Work

The built-in kickstand transforms the power bank into a desk companion. Attend virtual meetings, binge-watch your favorite series, or scroll comfortably while your device charges. The stable smartphone holder provides the perfect viewing angle in both portrait and landscape modes.

Travel-Ready Power Solution

With airline-friendly capacity and compact construction, this 10000mAh power bank fits easily into backpacks and pockets. The LED indicator ensures you always know when it’s time to recharge the unit.

If you want a magnetic wireless power bank that combines portability, fast charging, and multi-device compatibility, the Xech X-Charge MAG is the ultimate everyday carry accessory.
